evidence.label: annex:p16.measurable-kernel-randomization; single kernel 112-155 complete, whole-model clause 157-160 asserted

components.gap: Supply the full proof of the 'Consequently' assertion of thm:p16-measurable-kernel-randomization (body 90-94): every finite standard Borel kernel model has a representation X_v=F_v(X_pa(v),U_v) with mutually independent uniform U_v. By topological induction show that U_v is independent of the already constructed predecessors (functions of earlier U's), that K_v(X_pa(v),.) is therefore their conditional law of X_v, and that the joint law of the constructed tuple is P_K of def:p16-measurable-dag-kernels. Annex 157-160 only asserts 'Topological evaluation and successive conditioning show that its joint law is the kernel law'; the matching argument at annex 503-513 is not invoked.

components.gap: Supply the full proof of the stated consequence of thm:p16-measurable-response-component (body 304-307): that one conditional product law of (R,B) given C licenses integration of the whole family at a measurable random parameter depending on (B,C). Derive L(R|B,C)=L(R|C) as kernels (one null set) from R independent of B given C, and substitute the random parameter into the jointly measurable F via thm:p15-kernel-joint-measure; annex 567-573 is a two-sentence sketch. Also state or cite at annex 537-538 ('by the separation hypothesis') the two facts relied on: that exposing private disturbance roots preserves d-separation among the original vertices (now stated only later, annex 580-582) and the moral-separation bridge thm:p16-moral-separation-bridge.

Complete the proof of item 1 of thm:p16-measurable-mediation-fields (body 364-365) in the cross-world field (annex 586-626): annex 610-611 asserts the auxiliary mediator tuple is exactly M_b 'by topological evaluation on its restored ancestors', which requires every exposure child that is an ancestor of a mediator to lie outside D_Y (annex 607-608 feeds exposure input a to every exposure child in D_Y), but the listed graph facts (594-605) place in D_M only the heads of restored edges and their parents; prove that the other exposure children among the mediator ancestors lie in D_M. Also prove, rather than assert (613-615), that every vertex needed for Y outside C belongs to D_Y with exposure and mediator inputs exactly a,m, so that the auxiliary response is Y_{a,m} and R_0 independent of M_b given C follows from the response-component lemma.
